# NV Gateway

> NV Gateway is a free, open-source (Apache-2.0) Windows desktop app (Windows 10 and later) that runs a local OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API at http://127.0.0.1:12000 and forwards requests to NVIDIA's hosted models (build.nvidia.com / NVIDIA NIM API catalog) using the user's own NVIDIA Build API keys. Works with one key or many. NV Gateway tracks rate limits for each model separately: if a key hits a limit on one model, it stays available for your other models, and the request moves on to another key. Unofficial, independent app; not made, endorsed or supported by NVIDIA.

Key facts for agents:

- OpenAI-compatible base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:12000/v1` (Chat Completions `/v1/chat/completions`, Responses `/v1/responses`, models `/v1/models`).
- Anthropic-compatible base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:12000` without `/v1` (the client calls `/v1/messages`).
- Auth: the gateway token from the app's Endpoint screen, sent as a Bearer token. It is not the NVIDIA key.
- Admin API (used by the desktop app, needs the admin token): `http://127.0.0.1:12001/admin`.
- Ports: 12000 and 12001 are the application defaults, not fixed requirements. The gateway port is configurable in the app, and the admin API always listens on that port + 1, so the effective ports come from the app configuration (the Endpoint screen shows them).
- Models: NVIDIA's hosted model catalogue (synced daily). List current models with `GET /v1/models`.
- Windows only. No admin rights needed. The installer is unsigned; each release has `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
- Source: https://github.com/HaYkMnE/NV-Gateway (Apache-2.0). All releases are built by GitHub Actions from this source.

## Install (for agents; ask the user before running it)

- One command in PowerShell. It downloads the installer and `SHA256SUMS.txt`, verifies the SHA256, and installs silently for the current user: `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HaYkMnE/NV-Gateway/main/install.ps1 | iex`
- Review first: `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HaYkMnE/NV-Gateway/main/install.ps1 -OutFile install.ps1`, then `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1` (Bypass applies to that one process only).
- Build from source: `git clone https://github.com/HaYkMnE/NV-Gateway.git`, `npm ci`, `npx install-electron --no`, `npm run build` (Node.js 22.12 or later).
